responsibility: Implements the Arm backend’s builtin-function subsystem, especially ACLE, VFP, NEON, MVE, CDE, and crypto intrinsics. It defines the builtin type/qualifier machinery, constructs and registers builtin declarations from the .def tables, resolves overloaded or polymorphic builtin variants, validates immediates and lane arguments, expands builtin calls into target RTL or helper calls, maps selected internal functions to Arm vector builtins, and supplies target hooks for floating-point environment save/restore around atomic operations and for recording special per-function builtin usage such as Q-bit or GE-bit accesses.
same_name_distinction: Contains the implementation side of the Arm builtins pair: it uses the metadata and declarations from arm-builtins.h to construct builtin types and declarations, resolve overloaded intrinsic variants, validate intrinsic arguments, and expand builtin calls into backend operations.
